sloka: हयेन च हयं केचिन्निजघ्नुर्वानरा रणे।प्रहृष्टमनसः सर्वे प्रगृहीतमनःशिलाः ।। ६.६९.६३ ।।
transliteration: hayena ca hayaṁ kecinnijaghnurvānarā raṇe।prahṛṣṭamanasaḥ sarve pragṛhītamanaḥśilāḥ ।। 6.69.63 ।।

translations.english: The battlefield, covered with broken trees and mountains, fallen vanaras and rakshasas, seemed difficult to tread on ground.
